New Ashok Nagar.name: New Ashok Nagar

charges.duration: 0 up to 12 hours (per helmet)
Beyond 12 hours up to 24 hours (per helmet)

safety_tips.title: Mind the gap
safety_tips.description: Step carefully while boarding. Stand behind the yellow line until the train fully stops.

safety_tips.title: Watch your belongings
safety_tips.description: Keep bags in front of you during peak hours. Report unattended luggage immediately.

safety_tips.title: No eating or drinking
safety_tips.description: Consuming food or beverages inside the train is prohibited and carries a fine.

safety_tips.title: Priority seating
safety_tips.description: Seats near doors are reserved for elderly, pregnant, and Divyangjan passengers.

safety_tips.title: Emergency helpline
safety_tips.description: Use the Talk-Back button in the coach or call NCRTC helpline 1800-209-0200. Station Control Room available 24/7.

safety_tips.title: No photography
safety_tips.description: Photography inside trains, platforms, or restricted areas is strictly prohibited.

eco_impact.description: vs. driving Delhi–Meerut by private car
that would have burned in Delhi–Meerut traffic
every Namo Bharat coach removes ~350 cars per trip
NCRTC's energy mix includes renewable solar generation

faq.question: How do I buy a ticket for this station?
faq.answer: You can purchase tickets using the Namo Bharat app, NCMC (National Common Mobility Card), UPI, or at the station counter with cash.

faq.question: Is this station accessible for Divyangjan passengers?
faq.answer: Yes, New Ashok Nagar station is fully Divyangjan-friendly with ramps, elevators, and accessible facilities throughout.

faq.question: What is the operating schedule?
faq.answer: Namo Bharat trains operate from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM on weekdays and 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM on Sundays.

faq.question: Is parking available at this station?
faq.answer: Yes, parking is available for four-wheelers, two-wheelers, bicycles, and helmets with reasonable daily, night, and monthly rates.

faq.question: Are there food and beverage options?
faq.answer: Food stalls are available at the station, though eating inside trains is not permitted.
